prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-detail photorealistic 360-degree equirectangular environment panorama for a native 3D Go game, landscape 2:1.
Primary request: Inside a futuristic but very cluttered and crowded orbital space station work bay, a huge panoramic window shows black space filled with sharp stars and nearby space construction: unfinished orbital ring sections, intricate skeletal trusses, docked utility spacecraft, cranes, solar panels, scaffold gantries and work lights.
Composition: full seamless 360 longitude by 180 latitude spherical panorama, level horizon at image mid-height. The main huge observation window occupies the central third of the image, above the horizon; side walls wrap around with dense racks, patched panels, cable bundles, vent ducts, bolted structural ribs, storage bins, tools strapped to walls, compact glowing cyan and amber controls. Enclosed low ceiling packed with pipes, conduits and padded insulation. A cramped, lived-in industrial workstation, not a vast clean hall. No people. No game board, no table in center, no floating foreground objects: center bottom is clear scuffed dark charcoal metal deck to accommodate a real 3D table. Nearby walls around 3 meters from viewer. Window lower sill at waist height.
Style: believable practical science fiction film set photography, tactile worn graphite metal, faded ivory paneling, restrained amber warning labels, many small readable-looking but nonverbal instrument displays. Cool starlight through the large window and warm practical lights indoors, controlled highlights, comfortably visible details rather than crushed blacks. Fine, varied dense construction visible OUTSIDE in vacuum, no sky or clouds. No lens flare, no lettering overlays, no watermark. Maximum fine detail.
